chunks: Said (God): "O Iblis, what hindered you from adoring what I created by My own authority? Are you too proud, or too high and mighty?"

key_terms.بِيَدَيَّ: by My two hands (indicating special creation)

ai.seo_question: Why did Iblis refuse to prostrate to Adam according to Surah Sad?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Sad, Allah questions Iblis about his refusal to prostrate to Adam, whom He created with His own hands, highlighting the theological significance of Adam's unique status. The query distinguishes between Iblis's internal state of arrogance (istikbar) and his external claim of being among the 'aliyyin (higher or superior beings), a key point in Shia exegesis regarding the nature of his disobedience. This moment establishes the archetype of hubris against divine command, serving as a cautionary tale for humanity.
